thread:
riley: Hi folks, quick one — MDM enrollment succeeded but sudo asks for password that I never set. The onboarding doc mentions a temporary local admin but I don't see that account. macOS 13.5, MacBook Pro (Intel).

it-ops: Hey Riley, welcome! We normally create `redwood-temp-admin-<short>` during enrollment and then delete it post-setup. Can you check Users & Groups in System Settings or run `dscl . -list /Users`?

riley: `dscl . -list /Users` shows riley, _mbsetupuser, guest, root. No temp admin. Jamf shows policy `create_temp_admin` as successful though.

devsquad: Did you complete the Apple setup assistant? The hidden `_mbsetupuser` is the out-of-box account; sometimes enrollment completes before the temp admin is created. If you haven't finished the setup assistant steps (choose language, privacy), finish and reboot.

jamf-bot: Policy create_temp_admin ran at 2026-03-24T09:05:12Z - exit code 0. User created: redwood-temp-admin-9f3.

it-ops: Huh logs show it created. Can you try `sudo /usr/bin/dseditgroup -o read com.apple.access_screensharing` to see if the new user is present? Or open /var/db/dslocal/nodes/Default/users and grep for redwood-temp-admin.

riley: Found a plist at /var/db/dslocal/nodes/Default/users/redwood-temp-admin-9f3.plist but NFS permission denied when reading it via Finder. Command `sudo cat /var/db/dslocal/nodes/Default/users/redwood-temp-admin-9f3.plist` shows it exists. Why can't I login?

it-ops: The temp admin is created disabled until you accept the setup assistant. Log out of _mbsetupuser or complete setup, then unlock the account. Alternatively, we can reset the password from MDM and push a notification with creds. Would you prefer we reset?

riley: I completed setup earlier. Guess the account is disabled. If you can reset password and notify me, that'd be easiest.

it-ops: Reset pushed. New creds delivered to your work email via encrypted note. Try sudo with the temp admin username `redwood-temp-admin-9f3` and the provided password.

riley: Works now. Thanks! Quick reminder: onboarding doc could mention that temp admin may be hidden until setup assistant completes. I'll open a PR.

people-ops: Thanks, Riley! Adding note to the checklist. :memo:
